summary: Kootenai NF lookout: 40' pole L-4 tower built 1934, abandoned in the 1970s, destroyed 1990; manned in 1955 and reported a lightning fire on Pink Mountain that year.

facts.design: 40' pole L-4 tower built atop the northwest point
facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1970s and destroyed in 1990 per firelookout.com; no source describes the site today

events.note: 40' pole L-4 tower built atop the northwest point

notes_for_editor: Brief had no height; firelookout.com gives 40 ft, converted to 12.2 m. Three names appear: Pinto Point (firelookout.com), Pinto Lookout (Inter Lake, 1955) and Pinto Mountain Lookout (Evergreen, 1955). The Evergreen item says Friday evening, Sept. 10, but Sept. 10, 1955 was a Saturday, so the day may be wrong in the source; the story gives only the date. The 1970s abandonment is kept as text, not as an event with a year. No source describes the site today. Two WebSearch calls found nothing more on this lookout.
